purpose: Define strict SemVer syntax, package-qualified tags, lifecycle version classes, and publication eligibility without performing release or catalog writes.

package_tag.delimiter_rule: Use the terminal -v suffix whose remainder is a valid SemVer version.

version_classes.beta: An exact -beta.N prerelease, where N is a canonical non-negative decimal identifier.
version_classes.rc: An exact -rc.N prerelease, where N is a canonical non-negative decimal identifier.
version_classes.final: A SemVer version with no prerelease identifiers; this does not itself prove stable status.
version_classes.legacy_prerelease: Any other valid SemVer prerelease, including beta5, rc1, alpha, and preview forms.

security_boundaries: This contract performs no signature, catalog, cutover-policy, release, store, tag, or discovery verification.
A stable assertion requires an authorization decision supplied by a future verified active-catalog implementation.
A final-version artifact may be publication-eligible while remaining published-but-not-authorized and therefore not stable.
